semiconductor_relevance: High — Yongoo Technology specializes in electronic adhesives crucial for semiconductor packaging and assembly.
summary: Yongoo Technology Co., Ltd is a leading Chinese manufacturer specializing in electronic adhesives for semiconductor applications. The company focuses on innovation with a strong R&D team and offers products with independent intellectual property rights, including materials for IC packaging and LED packaging.

regional_presence.China: Yongoo has R&D and production centers in Changchun and sales centers in Shanghai.
